title: Meet the New Arlo Video Doorbell: A Smarter Way to See Who’s at the Door
summary: Discover the upgrades and new features found in the Arlo Video Doorbell 3rd Gen.
body_markdown:
The Arlo Video Doorbell 3rd Gen features updated components with enhanced specs designed to give you a high-quality feed in a durable, long-lasting package. Here’s what you can expect when you hook one up to your door:


- **2K HDR Video:** Get crisp, high-resolution footage with better contrast that can capture every detail you need so you know who exactly is ringing your doorbell.
- **Rechargeable battery:** A long-lasting battery means the Arlo Video Doorbell 3rd Gen can last months between charges, making battery anxiety a thing of the past.
- **Dual-Band Wi-Fi:** Our new Video Doorbell can automatically recognize and connect to the strongest band in your home wireless network, keeping you protected with the highest-quality connection possible.
- **Night Vision:** Keep your front door protected at all hours of the night, even if your front porch light is off.
- **Weather-resistant design:** Withstand the elements in one of four brilliant colors.
